jobs.ml_intern:
Machine Learning Engineer Intern — Nimbus Analytics (Bengaluru, Hybrid)

About the role
Join our applied ML team to build NLP and forecasting models used by 200+ enterprise customers.

What you'll do
- Train, evaluate and improve machine learning models in Python
- Build data pipelines with pandas and SQL
- Deploy models as REST APIs using Docker
- Track experiments and communicate results to stakeholders

Requirements
- Final-year student or recent graduate in CS or a related field
- Strong Python; experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow and scikit-learn
- Understanding of model evaluation metrics (precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC)
- Familiarity with NLP and transformer models
- Comfortable with SQL and Git

Nice to have
- Docker, FastAPI or Flask
- Cloud experience (AWS or GCP)
- MLOps tools such as MLflow
jobs.backend_swe:
Backend Software Engineer (2-4 years) — Ledgerly, Pune

Ledgerly builds payment and invoicing infrastructure for 30,000 small businesses.

Responsibilities
- Design, build and own microservices in Go or Java
- Build REST and gRPC APIs backed by PostgreSQL and Redis
- Work with event streaming on Kafka
- Ship through CI/CD pipelines to Kubernetes on AWS
- Improve observability with Prometheus and Grafana
- Write unit and integration tests; take part in code reviews and on-call

Requirements
- 2-4 years of professional backend development
- Strong in Go or Java (Spring Boot)
- Solid SQL and data modelling with PostgreSQL
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
- Understanding of system design, distributed systems and caching

Nice to have
- Kafka, gRPC, Terraform
- Payments or fintech domain experience
